grammar_focus: 过去完成时(had + 过去分词,表'过去的过去';与一般过去对比,before/after/when/until 时间从句,KS14)主考 + no sooner…than / hardly…when(一…就…,主句用过去完成)+ as if + 过去完成(好像)/ even though(即使,让步)(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 我的老朋友哈里森在回到英国以前,曾多年居住在地中海地区。他过去常幻想退休后回英国,并计划在乡间定居下来。他一回到英国就买下一幢房子住了进去。但紧接着他就开始抱怨那里的天气——因为即使那时仍是夏季,雨总是下个不停,而且常常冷得厉害。在阳光下生活了那么多年的哈里森对此感到惊奇,他的举动就好像从未在英国生活过一样。最后,他再也忍受不住,还没安顿下来就卖掉了房子,离开了这个国家。他多年来的幻想从此破灭——哈里森把每件事情都考虑到了,唯独没有想到天气。

grammar_card.title: 过去完成时:过去的过去
grammar_card.intro: 过去完成时用 had + 过去分词,表示'过去某动作之前'已经发生的事(过去的过去)。常和一般过去时对比:先发生的用过去完成,后发生的用一般过去。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: 过去的过去 → had + 过去分词
He had lived there for years before he returned.
对比:后发生 → 一般过去
He bought a house and went to live there.
before / after / when 时间从句
When he had finished lunch, he asked for water.
I had not understood it until he explained.
He had no sooner returned than he bought a house.

specialRules.rule: as if + 过去完成,表'好像(过去)已经…':He acted as if he had never lived in England.
even though = 即使,引出让步:even though it was summer, it rained continually。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why did Harrison sell his house so quickly?
options: He could not bear the cold, rainy English weather

passage: My old friend, Harrison, had lived in the Mediterranean for many years before he returned to England. He had often dreamed of retiring in England and had planned to settle down in the country. He had no sooner returned than he bought a house and went to live there. Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather, for even though it was still summer, it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold. After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock. He acted as if he had never lived in England before. In the end, it was more than he could bear. He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country. The dream he had had for so many years ended there. Harrison had thought of everything except the weather.
